businessModel: Free; funded by Alibaba’s AI, search and ad business, plus Quark Drive subscriptions
paidNote: Quark Drive storage is sold in paid tiers (not verified)
summary: Quark is Alibaba’s AI-first browser and app, popular in China. A January 2026 desktop relaunch built Qwen into the browser, alongside cloud drive, document scanning and AI writing tools.
bestFor: Chinese-language users who want AI search and study tools
notFor: Anyone who wants an independent privacy-first browser
Users who need a large extension ecosystem

pros.title: Qwen built in
pros.detail: The January 2026 desktop version uses Qwen as its core AI engine with a floating ball assistant.

pros.title: Cloud drive
pros.detail: Quark Cloud Drive is built in, with up to 6 TB of storage per its description.

pros.title: Scanner and study tools
pros.detail: AI document scanning, learning and writing tools.

cons.title: China-centric
cons.detail: Mostly used and supported in China; reviews call it less relevant elsewhere.

cons.title: Account required for key features
cons.detail: The desktop version needs a QR login from the phone app for drive and scanner features.

cons.title: Opaque privacy
cons.detail: AI features send data to Alibaba services; independent privacy review is limited.

faq.a: Alibaba cites over 200 million users in China and 100 million desktop users; Baidu’s wiki cites about 159 million monthly actives in June 2026. The figures measure different things.

faq.q: Which AI model does it use?

faq.a: Downloads are offered globally, but the product and its services are aimed at the Chinese market.

timeline.event: Quark launched as a mobile browser (not verified)
Revamped desktop AI browser with Qwen for Windows and macOS
Quark Drive launched as a standalone app

switching.note: Import options are not documented in the sources.

startup: Light mobile app; heavier on desktop
lowEnd: Strong on low-end Android in China
extras: Cloud drive, scanner, study and health tools
